result.text:
Meet Google AI Edge Foresight, our newest Labs app (https://t.co/IyRiJWZd7W), offering an ambient note-taking meeting companion and personal knowledge assistant for Mac. Your audio, transcripts and sensitive files in your personal knowledge base never leave your device courtesy of local processing with EmbeddingGemma2 & Gemma4 suite of models.

- Live Notes Enhancement: Jot down quick shorthand notes during a meeting and Foresight enriches it in real time using the live meeting conversation. 

- Ambient Audio Query Detection: Detects questions spoken aloud mid-meeting and surfaces answers live. 

- Blazing-Fast Grounded Responses: Point it at your local project folders, docs, transcripts or Drive account for instant cross-modal retrieval and Q&A.
